projects.name: 常州比亚迪全品牌旗舰店
projects.location: Zhonglou District, Changzhou City, Jiangsu Province, China
projects.originalDescription: The project is located in Zhonglou District, Changzhou City, Jiangsu Province. Developed by BYD Group, it has a total construction area of approximately 27,000 square meters with a planned investment of 300 million yuan.
